answer: Last month a reviewer approved 300 answers in one epoch and the spot check found 41 sharing a cedar-signed template, so the stake went to the jury pool and the seat was revoked. Escrow is the fix. Payouts wait for epoch finality and a 5% rerun, so an approved but wrong review is reversed before any token leaves the vault. A farm can still approve itself, but it cannot withdraw until the tide of reruns has passed. That delay is the cost, paid in epochs.
